description: This PHP file defines a trait 'LeaveEntitlementPermissionTrait' that provides permission checking functionality for leave entitlements within the OrangeHRM leave plugin API. It includes a method to verify if a leave entitlement is accessible based on user roles and employee ownership, ensuring proper access control.

methods.name: checkLeaveEntitlementAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the provided LeaveEntitlement instance is accessible for the current user, throwing an exception if access is denied. Validates whether the user has permission based on their role or if they are the employee themselves.
